interpretation: The legacy pair restoring-pressure branch increments d_gfs_pair_hits. With GFS_VARPRESS_W0 and phase1, active force accumulates var_fx/var_fy, active stored energy uses dte from variational face_work, and die_out selects dte. The pair-pressure counter is therefore not a measure of actually applied pair restoring force or AV heat in this branch. Close geometry may still matter for the real separation CFL; the counter alone does not classify pair provenance.
